Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Current state: Back inside the stairwell after retracing from the rooftop. The latest view is extremely close to a plain wall with vertical pipes; before the last right turn, a curved rail and stair edge were on the right. No active infected are visible. Health is 85; the pistol shows 15 loaded rounds, with previously observed unlimited reserve. Coach, Ellis, and Rochelle are nearby/visible as silhouettes; at the last clear HUD check Coach was 100, Rochelle 98, and Ellis 98.

Confirmed route update: The exterior doorway reached by climbing from the lower corridor leads around to the original fenced supply rooftop. It is a dead-end loop, not an onward route. The rooftop supply table repeatedly showed second-pistol/melee and first-aid prompts. The exterior melee prompt remained after E, and pickup was never confirmed. Do not repeat this rooftop loop or spend more time on its supplies.

Recent combat: While descending from the rooftop, a Hunter pinned the agent on the stairs. Health fell from 100 to 90 during the pin. Waiting did not immediately free the agent; K shove did not break the pin. J was tried, Rochelle rescued the agent, and the HUD reported Coach killed the Hunter. Health was 85 afterward. Ellis had also previously been reported killing a Smoker. No shots or damage have been observed since the rescue.

Recent navigation lessons: Re-entering ROOF ACCESS from the supply rooftop was difficult because of the open door leaf, supply table, doorjambs, and teammates blocking the narrow threshold. Repeated W, W+A, W+D, and small turns often returned to the table or pressed into blank walls. Success eventually came from backing away from the table, visually locating the separate dark doorway, centering it, and using short strafes to get around teammates. Inside, looking down and turning revealed descending treads beside/behind curved guardrails. Short lateral movement around rail ends worked better than pushing through rails. On the current lower descent, several advances again ended against walls or rails; an ascending flight was briefly visible on the right, while open landing space and descending treads appeared around guardrails. The exact direction from the current wall-facing position is not yet established.

Earlier route: Began healthy on the supply rooftop beside Rochelle. Two aligned E attempts failed on its first-aid kit. An unresponsive paneled side roof door remains unclassified. Stairs were found by looking down and moving around the curved rail. A downstairs door opened with E. In the debris corridor, K shoves plus pistol fire cleared infected without observed damage; ammo dropped 15→10 and R restored 15 while advancing. Following EXIT passed side rooms and uncollected pills. Solid areas included a pipe-filled left recess and corridor end/right side. An ELEVATORS sign with a left arrow led beneath EXIT into a long dim passage with a flame, bodies, and a right-side counter. A pale unlabeled upright figure near a far doorway disappeared without identification or engagement. Two aligned E attempts failed on corridor pain pills.

Room 500: Near plaque 500 and a cleaning cart, an unlabeled silhouette was briefly visible through the room near bright windows, then vanished. Repeated movement and E attempts only reached a narrow gap/dark-blue door panel; entry never occurred. Locked, blocked, or positioning-related remains unknown. Do not repeat those attempts unless new evidence appears.

Other untested route: After leaving room 500, a narrow passage led toward a brighter area. A closed white door with a red sign above it was visible ahead-left but never reached or tested. Forward/diagonal movement snagged on a central frame; pure A cleared it. Beyond was the lit stairwell leading to the now-confirmed rooftop loop.

Controls/mechanics observed: W/S move forward/back; A/D strafe. Left/Right arrows turn, but 0.25/0.5-second results vary. Mouse X sometimes adjusted aim, while some large attempted turns produced little change; large negative mouse-Y reliably looked down. E interacts when correctly positioned but aligned prompts do not guarantee pickup. J fires; K shoves ordinary arm’s-length infected effectively but did not break the Hunter pin. R reloads; Space jumps; flashlight illuminates nearby surfaces. Teammate silhouettes through walls do not establish a passage.

Active goal: Escape the current wall/rail alignment, finish descending to the lower corridor, and test the untested white door with the red sign. Then continue searching for the elevators with the team. If needed, retrace known corridor landmarks rather than returning upstairs. Unresolved: whether the white door opens, whether room 500 matters, what happened to the pale figure and room-500 silhouette, and whether side rooms contain useful supplies. No side room is confirmed necessary.
